artifacts.summary: 10-phase add-first/remove-last plan: TR-derived mirror module, derived modal_4/modal_b, three call-site rewrite phases, removal of 16 surplus constructors, verbatim TL/CN and TS restatements with TM-plus lockstep, appendix/docs regeneration, final gate.

memory_candidates.content: When demoting a primitive axiom constructor to a derived theorem in a Lean Hilbert system with many call sites, use add-first/remove-last: (1) add derived defs with statements byte-identical to the constructor index plus context-lifted `XAt Gamma` wrappers, (2) rewrite all construction sites while the constructor still exists (build stays green per file), (3) delete the constructor and let exhaustive-match compile errors enumerate the dispatcher arms. Restating an axiom's formula breaks any rfl-shaped per-arm embedding into a sibling system (e.g. PlusAxiom.ofTM), forcing lockstep restatement of the twin.
